headline: King lose all three matches before conference play
dek: King have lost at Trevecca, at Lee and at home to Milligan, scoring twice and conceding seven. North Greenville are the only other side yet to take a point; every other programme in the conference has at least a draw to its name.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southern Wesleyan's nine goals have come from seven different scorers, and are more than Erskine, King, Chowan and Ferrum have managed together.

wire.line: Lees-McRae and Shorter are the only sides yet to drop a point.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seventeen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist on Aug 13, while no match with a published final is missing its score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Against non-conference opponents the conference has drawn eight matches, one fewer than it has won, and has been beaten thirteen times.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Converse have scored seven goals and conceded four, and have one win to show for it.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Mount Olive's seven goals scored and seven conceded came from one heavy defeat at Mars Hill and one heavy win over Shaw.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Edouard Laberge has made twenty saves in Emmanuel's goal, and Emmanuel are still without a win.

last_match.line: Emmanuel remain without a win, though nobody has beaten them by more than a single goal.

next_match.line: Both sides arrive unbeaten; Lees-McRae have won every match they have played, Belmont Abbey have drawn more than they have won.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
